title.rendered: Container Offices for Sale in Bommasandra

content.rendered:
Looking for container offices for sale in Bommasandra? SAMAN Portable is a direct manufacturer of steel container offices, built at our own factory at Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099 — the same southern Bengaluru industrial belt that serves Bommasandra. That means you buy your unit factory-direct, not through a reseller, and get it delivered ready to use across the Bommasandra KIADB industrial area.

A container office gives you a secure, lockable workspace that arrives fully built. It suits site offices, factory admin cabins, security posts, sales counters and project rooms — anywhere you need a finished room quickly without the time and cost of conventional construction.

Container Offices for Sale in Bommasandra

Container offices for sale in Bommasandra are factory-built steel office cabins delivered ready to place and use. SAMAN Portable manufactures them on an MS steel frame to IS 2062, in 10ft, 20ft and 40ft sizes, with insulated walls, wiring points, windows and a lockable door. Being close to Bommasandra, we deliver and set up quickly across the area.

Container office sizes we supply

We build three standard container office sizes. Each can be customised with extra windows, partitions, AC provision, electrical points and exterior colour to match your site needs.

SizeTypical useFit-out
10ftSecurity post, single-person cabin, ticket/sales counter1 door, 1–2 windows, light + power points
20ftSite office, supervisor room, small team workspaceDoor, windows, partition option, multiple power points
40ftLarger office, multi-room admin block, meeting spaceMultiple rooms/partitions, full electricals, AC provision

All sizes are built as standalone units and many can be stacked or placed side by side for a larger modular office layout.

Why buy your container office direct from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Private Limited is a manufacturer, so your container office is built in-house and sold to you directly — no middleman markup.

  • Steel-frame build: every unit is built on an MS steel frame to IS 2062 for structural strength and weather resistance.
  • Quality systems: we manufacture under an ISO 9001:2015 certified process.
  • Warranty: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life.
  • Delivery and transit: delivery from ₹3,000, with typical transit of 3–5 days.
  • Returns: within 7 days of delivery or installation.

Delivery and installation in Bommasandra

Because our factory at Gopasandra sits in the same south Bengaluru industrial corridor as Bommasandra, units reach the area quickly and with low transport effort. Your container office leaves the factory fully built — frame, panels, doors, windows and electrical points already fitted — so on-site work is limited to placement and final connections. We deliver across Bengaluru and the wider Bommasandra industrial area, and our team handles offloading and setup so your unit is usable soon after it arrives.

Get a container office quote in Bommasandra

Tell us the size you need (10ft, 20ft or 40ft), your fit-out (windows, partitions, AC provision, power points) and your Bommasandra delivery point, and we will share a current price. You can browse the full range first — explore our container office range — then send your requirement. To get a quote, call +91 88616 22859 or use Send Enquiry, and we will confirm pricing, lead time and delivery for your site.

FAQs


What sizes of container office can I buy in Bommasandra?

We supply 10ft, 20ft and 40ft container offices. The 10ft suits a security post or single cabin, the 20ft a site or supervisor office, and the 40ft a larger or multi-room office. Each can be customised before dispatch.


How long does delivery to Bommasandra take?

Typical transit is around 3–5 days once your order is confirmed. As our factory is in the same south Bengaluru belt, units usually reach Bommasandra quickly. We confirm an exact timeline when you place the order.


Can the container office be customised?

Yes. You can add or move windows, add internal partitions, request AC provision, extra electrical points and a preferred exterior colour. Tell us your layout when you enquire and we build it to suit your work.


What warranty do you provide?

Every container office carries 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. The structure is built on an MS steel frame to IS 2062.


How do I order a container office for Bommasandra?

Share your size, fit-out and delivery point, and we will quote a current price and lead time. Call +91 88616 22859 or use Send Enquiry to start, or browse the container office range online first.


About SAMAN — container office manufacturer

Bommasandra's KIADB industrial estate off Hosur Road, beside Electronic City, runs factory and warehouse projects that use container offices as site offices, security cabins and stores.

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd (POS = Portable Office Solutions) is a direct container office manufacturer — ISO 9001:2015 (Cert No. E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (Cert No. E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (Cert No. E20250218647) certified; NSIC enlisted (Ref. NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207); DPIIT-recognised startup (Ref. DIPP56005); Udyam registered (UDYAM-KR-03-0172770); GST 29ABBCS7101B1ZR (Bangalore) and 09ABBCS7101B1ZT (Noida). We build on IS 2062 steel and dispatch factory-direct from Bangalore (Gopasandra, 560099) and Greater Noida (Jalpura, 201308) with a ₹3,000 default delivery charge and typical transit of 3–5 days. Call +91 88616 22859 or send an enquiry. See our container office cabin for a factory-built unit.
